with_social.description: Modo compacto CON intención — acción libre, intención cerrada a 5 valores y, solo con VLM_TARGET_SOURCE=vlm, un flag 't' (1/0) por persona ({target_line}). Usa {clip}/{id_map}/{example}/{keys}/{target_line}.
with_social.template:
{clip}. People are already boxed — do NOT output boxes or coordinates. Map: {id_map}.
For each ID ({keys}) give:
- "a": the action the person is doing, in a few words.
- "s": their intention, EXACTLY one of these 5 words: ATTENTIVE, AVAILABLE, BUSY, ENGAGED, MOVING.
  ATTENTIVE = looking at the camera/robot and seems to want to interact.
  AVAILABLE = free, not focused on anything, fine to approach.
  BUSY = focused on a solo task (phone, reading, working, eating...) or back turned to the camera.
  ENGAGED = talking or interacting with another person.
  MOVING = walking or changing position.
{target_line}Raw JSON only, exactly this shape: {{{example}}}

no_social.description: Modo compacto SIN estado social — solo descripción de acción. Usa {clip}/{id_map}/{example}/{keys}.
no_social.template:
People are already boxed — do NOT output boxes/coordinates, only classify. Posture (sitting/standing/walking) comes from another sensor — never mention it in the answer. Use the scene around each person (nearby objects, other people, what they're facing/near) as context.
{clip}. Map: {id_map}.
Keys: {keys}. JSON (fill in <action> with your real word; never output "<action>" literally): {{{example}}}
Per ID: 1-2 words for the specific real thing they're doing or attending to right now (gaze, gesture, activity) — never a posture word. If they're just looking at something (screen, camera, space) with no other activity, say what/where they're looking or 'thinking', e.g. 'watching screen', 'watching camera', 'thinking' — 'idle' is only for genuinely no discernible focus at all. Judged independently per person.
Raw JSON only, no extra text, no boxes.

per_person.description: Una consulta por persona (VLM_QUERY_MODE=per_person): el clip lleva SOLO la caja de esa persona, gruesa y amarilla. Medido 2026-10-02 en 6 videos (268 etiquetas a ojo): con el prompt de grupo el VLM copiaba la misma etiqueta a todos (37/75 trozos); por persona, 22/75. Usa {clip}.
